description: She wears a floor-length rust-red long-sleeved gown over a cream underdress, with restrained cream-gold embroidered neckline, cuffs and hem. A brown belt with round clasp sits at the waist; a brown-gold mantle hangs from paired round shoulder brooches linked by a chain. Brown leather shoes are visible below the hem. The high square neckline, wrist-length sleeves and opaque unbroken skirt provide modest coverage. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
